items.title: Jeff Riddick Interview, 1983-07-14
items.q: I knew Eddie Miller. When I first came to New Orleans, Eddie Miller was 15 years old. I was 19.

ctx.x: Did he sound at all like anybody that I'd know?
Oh, yes. Very much, very much like him. You want to know who? Yes. Miller. Got a tone like Eddie Miller and played a style like Eddie Miller.
Was he older or younger than Eddie?
